title: bot.ability.conversation.input
description: Conversation input identified by source identities and an optional target identity set; an empty target set represents an ambient input with an unknown addressee.

source_ids.description: One or more opaque identities that produced this content.
source_ids.title: Source Ids

target_ids.description: Zero or more opaque identities addressed by this content; an empty set means the addressee is unknown or the input is ambient.
target_ids.title: Target Ids

content.description: Modality-specific content carried without interpretation by Conversation. text/* uses str; audio/* uses bytes (base64 on JSON wires); other modalities may use structured objects.
content.title: Content

content_type.description: Content media type or modality label; it is data, not an event route.
content_type.title: Content Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of raw PCM audio content in hertz. Required for correct STT packaging when content_type is audio/pcm, audio/raw, or similar non-container audio. Omit for text and WAV.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Channel count of raw PCM audio content. Omit for text and self-describing containers.
channels.title: Channels

parent.description: The stimulus this turn was heard as (mosfet.py's TurnData.parent), an envelope {event, data}: heard speech's bot.ability.listening.speech.output, stamped by the producer; host-created inputs omit it.
parent.title: Parent

participants.description: The participants its producer stamps (the environment that delivers it): the receiving bot's own identity as a target, own true, when target_ids names it. Stamped only by that producer; never inferred.

items.description: Someone who took part in a stimulus: an opaque, producer-stable identity reference and the role it played (source: who produced it; target: who it was addressed to).

ref.description: Opaque, producer-stable identity such as a phone number, an app person id, or a chat handle. Never a display name chosen by the bot.
ref.title: Ref

role.description: source: who produced the stimulus (speaker, sender). target: who it was addressed to.
role.title: Role

own.description: True when the producer knows this participant is the bot itself, for example the bot's own voice heard back or the voice it spoke with. Stamped only by that producer; never inferred.
own.title: Own

resembles.description: For an identity its producer made just now (nobody it knew): the known identities it resembles, best first, at most 3. Stamped only by that producer; never a link.

items.description: A known identity this new one resembles: its ref and how similar the two are (-1..1). Perception data only: it links nothing, and it is never a print.

ref.description: The ref of the known identity, as its producer stamps it.
ref.title: Ref

similarity.description: How similar the two are, -1..1; higher is more alike.
similarity.title: Similarity

resembles.title: Resembles

items.title: Participant

participants.title: Participants
